def handle(app, svc):
    resp = svc.apply(app)

    # API v2 (Northwind "current API version")
    result = resp.get("result", {})
    outcome = result.get("outcome")
    credit_limit = result.get("credit_limit", 0)

    # Map v2 outcome to action
    if outcome == "approved":
        action = "issue"
        limit = credit_limit
    elif outcome == "declined":
        action = "decline"
        limit = 0
    elif outcome == "manual_review":
        action = "queue_review"
        limit = 0
    else:
        # Unknown outcome -> safest to route for review
        action = "queue_review"
        limit = 0

    # Network referral rule (all partners):
    # self_employed applicant with requested_limit strictly > 6000
    # must be queue_review instead of issued (decline stays decline).
    if (app.get("employment") == "self_employed"
            and app.get("requested_limit", 0) > 6000
            and action == "issue"):
        action = "queue_review"
        limit = 0

    return {"action": action, "limit": limit}
